resource.description: Menopause Vent Sesh (Online Event): Real Talk, Real Support Welcome to a space where you don’t have to hold it all together. This virtual gathering is for women going through menopause who are tired of feeling alone, confused, or just plain over it. Whether you're dealing with hot flashes, anxiety, sleep issues, weird supplements, or mood swings that come out of nowhere.

Step into your power with Carly L in this dynamic Kundalini Yoga class—a transformative blend of movement, breathwork (pranayama), mantra, and meditation designed to energize your body, clear your mind, and connect you with your highest self. Rooted in ancient yogic tradition, Kundalini Yoga activates your inner vitality and strengthens your nervous system, helping you move through life with more clarity, resilience, and joy. Carly creates a supportive and uplifting space where all levels are welcome, whether you're brand new or deepening your practice. In each class, you’ll experience: Kriyas (intentional movement sequences) Breathwork to balance and energize Mantra and sound for mental focus Deep relaxation and guided meditation Come as you are. Leave more aligned, empowered, and awake.

Join Jenny for a calming and restorative breathwork session designed to ease stress, reconnect you to your body, and bring gentle awareness to your inner world. This class offers a safe and supportive space to explore the healing power of the breath through simple, accessible techniques that anyone can do—no prior experience needed. Together, we'll slow down, soften into presence, and cultivate a deep sense of calm and clarity. Perfect for those seeking relaxation, emotional balance, or a mindful reset during a busy week. What to expect: Guided gentle breathing exercises Mindful awareness practices Optional light movement or meditation A nurturing, non-judgmental environment All are welcome. Just bring yourself and your breath.
